name: dcf
source: He et al., Double Correction Framework for Denoising Recommendation, KDD 2024; github.com/bruno686/DCF @ 873cee3 (loss.py PLC_uncertain_discard, main.py). Code differs from the paper (position-indexed loss memory, no label flip, constant relabel ratio); the port follows the code, see rq1kit/dcf.py
grid_source: Paper App. A.2 tunes relabel ratio R in {0, 0.01, 0.03, 0.09, 0.27}, sigma^2 in {0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1}, time step v in {1..5} (100 points). 8-trial budget: R in {0.01, 0.03, 0.09, 0.27} x sigma^2 in {0.001, 0.01} (the paper reports larger sigma^2 degrades; R = 0 and sigma^2 = 0 switch the components off); v = 3 (authors' default, middle of its range). Drop rate 0.2 and 30000 gradual iterations are the authors' defaults (the paper gives no values)
memory: plain LightGCN/MF plus two float vectors of 2 x n_train (running mean, counter): under 100 MB on Amazon-Book
